title: Growing Together: Mentorship at SurgicGuide
html:
At SurgicGuide, we believe that great teams are built by helping people grow.

Our Human Resources team plays an important role in creating a supportive environment where new members can learn, ask questions, and gradually find their place within the company. For our interns in particular, the first few weeks are an opportunity to understand not only their role, but also how different teams work together in a biotech company.

In this session, our Head of Human Resources spent time with our intern, discussing his work, introducing him to our internal workflows, and sharing some practical advice on making the most of his internship.

For us, an internship is more than simply gaining work experience. It is about learning from others, asking good questions, taking initiative, and becoming part of the team.

We’re excited to support the next generation of biotech talent and see where their curiosity takes them.

Welcome to SurgicGuide — let’s grow together.
